content.title: CPU % - Web, App, Data
content.query:
Syslog | extend event=parse_json(SyslogMessage) | where tostring(event.event) == "host_metrics"
| summarize CPU=avg(todouble(event.cpu_percent)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), host=tostring(event.host)
| render timechart

content.title: RAM % - Web, App, Data
content.query:
Syslog | extend event=parse_json(SyslogMessage) | where tostring(event.event) == "host_metrics"
| summarize RAM=avg(todouble(event.memory_percent)) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), host=tostring(event.host)
| render timechart

content.title: Czas odpowiedzi API w ms
content.query:
Syslog | extend event=parse_json(SyslogMessage) | where tostring(event.event) == "http_request"
| summarize AverageMs=avg(todouble(event.duration_ms)), P95Ms=percentile(todouble(event.duration_ms), 95) by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m)
| render timechart

content.title: Żądania HTTP według kodów
content.query:
Syslog | extend event=parse_json(SyslogMessage) | where tostring(event.event) == "http_request"
| extend code=toint(event.status_code)
| extend class=case(code < 300, "2xx", code < 400, "3xx", code < 500, "4xx", "5xx")
| summarize Requests=count() by bin(TimeGenerated, 1m), class
| render columnchart

content.title: Logi FastAPI i PostgreSQL
content.query:
Syslog
| where ProcessName in ("gearpass", "gearpass-postgresql", "gearpass-health")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, ProcessName, SeverityLevel, SyslogMessage
| order by TimeGenerated desc
| take 100
